verdict.rationale: Evidence shows only the rendering runtime is open-source (rive-docs-21, rive-gh-1/2/3), while the Editor itself is a hosted SaaS product requiring Rive's cloud service—there is no documentation of a self-hostable full design platform. Community discussion explicitly confirms this gap, noting the MIT license covers only 'a subset of the Rive runtime that requires the Rive Editor to build content for' (rive-comm-5), meaning the actual design/editing platform cannot be self-hosted.
